scope: Isolated CPU algorithms; no Falcor rendering, GPU measurements, file IO, meshoptimizer, or buffer uploads in timed regions
math: Minimal scalar float2/float3 shim; original non-CDT algorithm bodies retained
method_label_note: PCL Greedy Projection and LMT MWT are the branch's custom heuristics; not official PCL or exact MWT
software_quad_model: One pixel-center sample per pixel; each triangle schedules four lanes in every 2x2 quad containing at least one covered pixel; no depth, MSAA, clipping or hardware quantization
